description.default: The address of the dedicated licensed mailbox that REV | Retention | Retention & Erasure Helper (SAR extract) sends the subject access request extract from (TAD rev 37, ADR-091, delivery option B). A tenant mail-flow rule encrypts every message from this sender. EMPTY means protected sending is off in this environment: nothing is emailed and the process owner is told to use option A. Fill it only after the A-SAR-4, A-SAR-13 and A-SAR-14 checks have passed in this environment (ADR-091 items 4 and 7). The same address in every environment; supplied by Revitalise's tenant administrator, never committed (C-TECH-047).
